subject: Follow-up: Stakeholder roster & procurement timeline for HelixBio
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@helixbio.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@helixbio.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Stakeholder roster & procurement timeline for HelixBio

Hi Emma / Carlos —

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciate the time and the candid discussion about your ML roadmap for bioinformatics pipelines. Quick recap and a few asks so we can move the procurement conversation forward: 

Summary from today:
- Goal: pilot Redwood Inference to serve sequence-annotation models with predictable latency for interactive analysis.
- Primary success criteria: sub-200ms 95th pct latency for 512-token average queries; token-cost target to stay within PoC budget.
- Pilot scope: 3 models, 2 non-prod GPUs, 1 stage for integration testing.

Open asks / next steps (can you share?):
1) Stakeholder roster — who owns economics/approvals (we heard Carlos might be the budget owner), and who owns security/compliance and procurement gating?
2) Procurement path — do you have an internal RFP process / PO cadence? Are terms routed via Legal first?
3) Security contacts — who should we engage for the SOC 2 questionnaire and network configuration (IP allowlist / VPC specifics)?
4) Timeline — target decision window you expect for a Q3 pilot?

If you prefer, a short org chart and a procurement-contact email will get us unblocked. I can then put together a one-page mutual action plan showing milestones, deliverables, and the handoff to your security and procurement teams.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- You send roster/org chart + procurement POC + any RFP template (if applicable).
- We schedule a 30-min intro with procurement + security + our solutions engineer (Rishi).

I attached a short one-pager that outlines the pilot profile we discussed.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
(415) 555-0137

Attachment: Redwood_pilot_onepager.pdf (1 page PDF)

From: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@helixbio.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@helixbio.com>
Cc: procurement@helixbio.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Stakeholder roster & procurement timeline for HelixBio

Hi Sergio —

Nice to meet you on the call. Quick answers below and I attached the org chart + procurement spreadsheet you can use as a starting point.

Short answers:
- Economic buyer / budget owner: Carlos Mendez (VP Ops) — he signs for PoCs above $40k.
- Procurement lead: procurement@helixbio.com (procurement team runs standard PO + 45-day payment) — I copied them.
- Legal review: our in-house counsel (Laura Kim) handles SLA/terms for third-party vendors.
- Security / compliance: security@helixbio.com handles SOC 2, pen-test coordination, and network rules.
- Target window: ideally run the pilot in Q3 (kickoff late August), decision by mid-August.

Attachments included:
- HelixBio_org_chart_v2.pdf (basic org chart, highlights Carlos, Laura, and security contact)
- HelixProcurement_RFP.xlsx (procurement team template; has PO terms and insurance requirements)

I'll follow up with procurement directly to suggest a 30-min intro. Carlos — looping you in for visibility.

Best,
Emma Zhao
Head of Bioinformatics | HelixBio
emma.zhao@helixbio.com

Attachments: HelixBio_org_chart_v2.pdf; HelixProcurement_RFP.xlsx

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@helixbio.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@helixbio.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, procurement@helixbio.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Stakeholder roster & procurement timeline for HelixBio

Emma — thanks, got the files and that is super helpful. Quick note and proposed scheduling: 

1) We will review the RFP and return a redline/answers by next Tue (20 Jul). Rishi (cc'd) will validate the architecture and the SOC 2 evidence we typically provide.

2) Proposed intro options with procurement + security + our team (30 minutes):
   - Option A: Tue, 20 Jul 10:00-10:30 PT
   - Option B: Wed, 21 Jul 15:00-15:30 PT

Could Carlos / procurement confirm a preferred slot? If neither works, send a couple windows and we'll accommodate.

3) To help our legal team prepare, can you confirm if there are any required vendor agreements (NDA already done?) and if Helix requires an in-country data processing addendum?

We'll prepare a one-page mutual action plan after the procurement intro so all stakeholders have clear milestones (pilot start, security checklist complete, PO issued). Monica on my team will lead onboarding during the pilot.

Sergio / Emma —

Thanks for the summary. Option A works best for me (Tue 20 Jul 10:00 PT). Procurement — can you confirm availability and send calendar invite?

A couple quick clarifications on our side:
- We usually require a standard vendor terms questionnaire returned with the RFP; please include a contact from your legal team if you expect any deviations.
- Data residency: for the pilot we can accept Redwood hosted in US regions, but production may require EU region options later — can you note that in the MAP?

Procurement team, please coordinate.

Regards,
Carlos Mendez
VP Operations | HelixBio
carlos.mendez@helixbio.com
